item.description: Andrew Dean Robson, 35, has been sentenced to seven years in jail for a car crash that resulted in a pregnant teenager losing her baby. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Alleged kitchen knife murderer Conor O’Neill denied bail
item.description: A 40-year-old man who allegedly stabbed his 47-year-old partner while the pair were driving through a Northern Territory suburb has been refused bail. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Multitude of factors' behind firing of chef who refused pineapple on pizza
item.description: Brisbane restaurant manager Elliot Ingram says there were a number of reasons behind the firing of a chef who refused to put pineapple on a customer's pizza. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Young victim of hotel fall died in 'tragic' accident, parents say
item.description: The grief-stricken parents of Natasha Lawton, who died in a fall at a Hindley Street hotel in Adelaide's CBD, have described their daughter as someone who "loved life and lived every minute". Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Data centre plan could bring water into Queensland, minister says
item.description: Queensland Water Minister Ann Leahy says rapid industrial growth in the Western Downs could help drive private investment in major water infrastructure projects, including the long-discussed Nathan Dam project. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: Alongside listing the home as a place Mr Wood could live, the person also offered $1 million in cash. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Ex-CFMEU boss admits to illegal tirade against AFL umpiring boss

item.title: Paraguay's president tangled up in Ueno banking crisis
item.description: Paraguay's president has stepped down after the collapse of Ueno Bank plunged the country into a political crisis. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Teen who allegedly attacked boy in filmed assault refused bail
item.description: A 14-year-old boy appears in court charged over an alleged attack on a 13-year-old boy which was filmed and shared on social media. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Beau Lamarre-Condon tells double murder trial shooting of Jesse Baird wasn’t intentional but ‘it was my fault’
item.description: Former NSW police officer gives evidence for a second day after pleading not guilty to murdering Baird and Luke Davies in early 2024 The day in court: Prosecution begins cross-examination of double murder accused Beau Lamarre-Condon Beau Lamarre-Condon “stands by” his decision to shoot Jesse Baird but did not intend to kill him, the New South Wales supreme court has heard. The former police officer is accused of fatally shooting Baird and his partner, Luke Davies, with his police service weapon in Baird’s Paddington home in Sydney on 19 February 2024. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Outrage from tiny town results in electoral commission backflip
item.description: The VEC had decided the western Victorian town of Kaniva would go without a polling booth on election day, but a group of concerned residents weren't having it. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: 'Not a waste of money': Authority to be dissolved after years of issues
item.description: The waste authority responsible for the failure of South West WA's FOGO waste system is being dissolved after repeated environmental breaches cost ratepayers millions of dollars. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: Baseballer loses sight in one eye in 'horrific freak accident'
item.description: An Adelaide club baseballer struck by a ball in an "horrific freak accident" during a weekend game has permanently lose sight in his right eye, his close friend and former teammate says. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.description: From asparagus to cherries, these are some of the best fruit and vegetables to look for in November. Fuente: ABC News Australia.

item.title: More than 40 pilot whales die after mass stranding in New Zealand’s North Island
item.description: Rescuers were unable to save the whales after they became beached on a remote and rocky part of the country More than 40 pilot whales died after a mass stranding event on New Zealand’s remote east coast, conservation officials said on Friday, despite rescue efforts by volunteers and conservation workers. The Department of Conservation (DoC) said 43 whales had died in the mass stranding along the Ngawi coast on the south-eastern tip of the North Island. Continue reading... Fuente: The Guardian - Environment.

item.title: Australia faces same issues that flipped control of US Congress in midterms, experts say
item.description: Anthony Albanese’s government has taken a blow due to Iran war but voter anxiety around cost of living and datacentres may hit harder Get our daily political email , free app or daily news podcast The Democrats’ stunning midterm victory should broaden Australia’s alliance with the US, observers say, even as a new power base emerges in Washington, affecting Aukus, datacentre development and relations with China. Cabinet ministers, diplomats and Australia’s defence industrial sector closely watched the results this week, with control of the US Congress flipping to the Democrats and the outlook… Fuente: The Guardian - World.

item.title: Investigation links Australian deforestation to beef farming and major bank loans
item.description: ACF's latest report, "Bulldozers and Broken Promises," an investigation into deforestation, has ruffled a few feathers. But someone has to do it. Why? Because deforestation is a huge problem in Australia. Fuente: Phys.org.

item.title: Murder trial hears woman's injuries 'consistent with strangulation'
